## Why

Owner 2026-10-25: the Questions tab (S27) shows open adj records read-only; the owner wants to answer them in the TUI. adj decide is owner-only for agents (AGENTS.md); the TUI is the owner's tool, so adj 159 (ui.answer-adj) records that the TUI may run it after a confirm. Decisions of 2026-10-25: pick an option, type the reason, confirm the exact command, --by from the project's git user.name. S28 (engine answer toggle that files an adj ask and decide) is separate and does not add this path.

## Files

- `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go`: a Decide(ctx, root, id, option, why, by) write wrapper running `adj decide ID OPTION --why TEXT --by NAME --root DIR`, plus a free-text form `adj decide ID --text TEXT --why TEXT`; errors returned verbatim.
- `internal/daemon/wire.go`, `handlers.go`, `client.go`: a write method `adj.decide` (proposed; params project, id, option or text, why, by) and its client call; it refuses an unknown project or a record that is not open.
